queries:
SELECT sc.structstate, COUNT(sc.cureregistry) AS record_count
FROM scanconservation sc
INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY sc.structstate
SELECT healtheval, COUNT(*) FROM sites GROUP BY healtheval;

SELECT CASE WHEN healtheval IS NULL OR TRIM(healtheval) = '' THEN 'Missing' ELSE healtheval END AS healtheval, COUNT(*) AS site_count FROM sites GROUP BY CASE WHEN healtheval IS NULL OR TRIM(healtheval) = '' THEN 'Missing' ELSE healtheval END;
SELECT equipstatus, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment) AS share FROM equipment GROUP BY equipstatus
SELECT equipstatus, 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment) AS percentage FROM equipment GROUP BY equipstatus
